description: This file defines a static class and a readonly generic struct related to directory results in Orleans Runtime, including factory methods and a method to attempt retrieving the result.

classes.name: DirectoryResult<T>
classes.description: A readonly generic struct encapsulating a directory result with a version, providing a method to attempt retrieving the contained result if versions match.

methods.name: FromResult
methods.description: Creates a DirectoryResult with a specific result and version.

methods.name: RefreshRequired
methods.description: Creates a DirectoryResult indicating a refresh is required, with a given version.

methods.name: TryGetResult
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the result if the provided version matches the stored version.
